description: Creates a bookmark or updates the matching bookmark URL, title, favicon, and folder.

fleetId.description: Fleet ID whose bookmark store should be changed.

title.description: Bookmark title to store. Used as the new title when updating an existing bookmark.

faviconUrl.description: Optional favicon URL to store with the bookmark.

folderId.description: Opaque folder ID to place the bookmark under. Omit for the root folder.

purpose.description: Describe why you are saving or refreshing this bookmark, e.g., saving an important page for later

anyOf.description: Created or updated bookmark result fields.
Null when the underlying bookmark API returns no result.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

anyOf.description: Created or updated bookmark result fields.
Null when the underlying bookmark API returns no result.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

observation.description: Directly observed failure fact; it must not infer an unobserved browser side effect.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

details.description: Only fields listed by the public error definition detailFields are returned; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
